name: boot-soak
description: Boots the ISO to the live desktop and stops. The soak (.github/workflows/boot-soak.yml) does it many times on fresh runners, from the optical drive and from a USB stick, to catch the rare boot that stops in casper's scripts (about 1 in 10–20 in the ISO runs, a different line each time, no kernel message); such a boot leaves stall.txt (tests/vm/run.py: QEMU's state, busy or idle vCPUs, the host's load, the kernel's SysRq dump). The VM is the user journeys' one.
